```{r}

dim(hbsc2018)

```

```{r}


# get column names
cols <- colnames(hbsc2018)
cols <- strsplit(cols, ";")[[1]]
cols <- trimws(cols)

# split into 3 roughly equal columns
n <- length(cols)
mat <- matrix(cols, ncol = 5, byrow = TRUE)

# print as a table in R Markdown
kable(mat) #, col.names = c("Column 1", "Column 2", "Column 3"))
```
